paragraphs: From Loughrea test centre, depart on Station Road and take your 1st right onto Main Street
Continue straight ahead as the road becomes Dunkellin Street
Take a slight right onto the R380 shortly after
Turn right into Ashlawn Drive and be ready to pull in for a stop as you arrive in the Ashlawn estate
Move off again from Ashlawn and carry out a turnabout (U-turn) on the quiet estate road
Continue along Ashlawn, then at the end of the road turn right back onto Ashlawn Drive
Follow it out to the roundabout on the Loughrea Bypass
At the roundabout take the 2nd exit (effectively a left) onto the Loughrea Bypass, then leave the next mini-roundabout with a slight left to stay on the bypass
Pull in briefly on the bypass when instructed, then rejoin traffic
Continue along the Loughrea Bypass through the next roundabout, again taking the slight left exit to remain on the bypass
Turn right off the bypass, then at the end of the road turn left onto Bride Street
Take your 1st right into Jairdin Drive and keep left as the road bends through the estate
Pull in for a stop, then move off and complete a turnabout on Jairdin Drive
At the end of Jairdin Drive turn right turn left onto Bride Street and pull in when asked
Move off once more along Bride Street, continuing straight as it becomes Main Street and then Dunkellin Street heading back through town
Take a slight right onto the R380 and follow it for just over a kilometre
Turn left into Radharc na Sleibhte keep right as the road bends, and arrive back at the finish near the Loughrea test centre area
